name: Guns
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of conflict and the necessity of defense, as seen in Nehemiah where workers held weapons even while laboring. God equips His people with strength and skill for battle, teaching their hands to fight and granting victory over adversaries, as David praises in Psalms. At the same time, the sanctity of human life is emphasized, with God requiring accountability for the shedding of blood. Trust in the Lord’s deliverance is paramount, as He hears the cries of the righteous and rescues them from troubles, underscoring that reliance on God, not weapons alone, is essential.
